thread:
leo_ae: FYI — Marigold wants to run a POC with their in-house 13B-quant variant. Key asks: VPC + KMS, <20ms p95 for 16-token responses, and an enterprise pricing estimate. Can we run compatibility check this week?
emily_sales: Thanks Leo. They want dedicated on-prem later but start hosted for speed. Main blocker is the security questionnaire (they require HSM integration) and pricing approval for reserved capacity.
kai_ml: Quick probe: is the variant standard transformer MLP + RMSNorm? any custom ops?
leo_ae: They sent a model artifact link and say "llama-compat, 8-bit quant with a custom GELU implementation". Attached short manifest.
joran_sre: @kai_ml tagging because custom GELU might need custom kernel — could impact latency. Also need to know KV cache layout; our continuous batching assumes standard KV ordering.
kai_ml: Understood. Can we ask for a small inference package (onnx/ggml/torchscript) and a single-utterance log? If we can run a quick perf run on a dev node we can validate p95.
emily_sales: I'll request the artifact + minimal runbook from Marigold. Also they want an SLA clause for failover to a smaller model if latency spikes. Is that doable?
nora_ops: Failover is doable via routing policy but need to pre-approved fallback variant in the catalog. Also autoscaling for dedicated pools would be required for consistent p95.
marta_security: HSM/KMS note: we can integrate customer KMS in Private deployments; hosted requires KMS proxy + attestation. For on-prem they can use HSM. We need answers on data at rest retention and key rotation policy.
leo_ae: Marigold legal asked for SOC2 + penetration test artifacts. Can we provide redacted reports?
marta_security: We have SOC2 report template and pen-test summary for customers with NDA. I'll start the NDA thread.
pricebot: Estimated committed monthly for Dedicated 4xA100 equiv + 99th p95 SLA: $XX,XXX/mo. Hosted burst pricing differs. This is a rough ballpark until we confirm memory/batch.
emily_sales: Can we get a more concrete number if they commit to 2-month trial and reserve minimal capacity?
pricebot: If they reserve 2xA100-equivalent with pre-warming and KV cache hot shards, estimate $YY,YYY/mo pro forma. I'll attach per-token delta once we have the model size.
kai_ml: To validate variant compatibility I'll need: model artifact, tokenizer files, example prompt set (50 samples), and a 1-2 minute raw trace showing KV cache behavior.
leo_ae: I'll collect those and push today. Any blockers for onboarding the variant into the catalog?
nora_ops: Two gating items: security sign-off (Marta) and a quantization profile check (Kai). Also need to register the variant with a unique build id and enable canary routing.
joran_sre: For latency: set batching target to 8ms batch interval and max_batch_tokens=2048 as starting point. If custom GELU causes slowdown we'll fallback to a CPU-compatible optimized kernel or smaller variant.
kai_ml: If they provide TorchScript we can try compile+kernel selection. If only ggml we'll run the quant profile. Note: custom GELU sometimes increases instruction count ~1.1x — expect 10-15% latency hit.
marta_security: Also need their data flow diagram (DFD) and list of third-party integrations for questionnaire.
leo_ae: I'll get DFD + vendor list. Marigold also asked about bring-your-own-key (BYOK) during the trial.
marta_security: BYOK for hosted is tricky — we support customer-managed keys via KMS proxy, but require HSM attestation for certain industries. I'll outline the requirements.
emily_sales: Timeline: ask Marigold for artifacts today, Kai to run perf by Friday, Marta to push NDA + security checklist, Nora ops to scope dedicated capacity and quote, and I'll prepare trial contract.
pricebot: Once we have model size + batch profile I can generate a formal quote.
leo_ae: Great — thanks team. I'll post the artifacts here when I have them.
deploy-bot: Reminder: create ticket INF-4721 to track Marigold POC onboarding steps.
